name: Franzlbauer
beschreibung:
Nestled in a sunny spot beneath the Wilder Kaiser, Franzlbauer in Soell provides a restful farm holiday experience. Featuring cosy wooden furnishings, it is a wonderful retreat for families and outdoor lovers.

Hiking routes, cycling paths, and the renowned SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental are conveniently close.
kurzbeschreibung: The Franzlbauer farmstead in Soell offers authentic countryside experiences at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser.
